\begin{example} \end{example}[immersion with self-intersection] 1. ch0:3.4

$\alpha (t)=(t^3-4t,\, t^2-4)$ (Fig. 7) is an immersion $\alpha :\mathbb {R}\to \mathbb {R}^2$ with a self-intersection at $t=2,t=-2$. Hence $\alpha $ is not an embedding. \end{example}
